scope: Stage-2 redirected identity and pinned SHA, repository tree/README/setup metadata, installation documentation and one retained FEM linear-elasticity demo inspected statically. The broader DEM/LBM/CFD/PFM/FEM toolbox was not exhaustively mapped.

unresolved_findings.finding: Runtime dependency versions are not pinned in setup.py, including JAX, jaxlib and the scientific/solver stack.
The repository states that FEM development moved to JAX-FEM and the retained JAX-AM FEM implementation will not receive future updates.
The pinned installation documentation still uses the historical tianjuxue/jax-am clone URL while Stage 2 verifies the same repository identity at the redirected CMSL-HKUST location.
Installation has a documented petsc4py platform sensitivity and no pinned compatible PETSc, petsc4py, JAX and accelerator environment is supplied.
No bundled numerical reference result or explicit acceptance threshold was identified for the bounded FEM demo.

notes: CR000156 is represented as a simulator/solver toolbox, not as a PINN implementation.
